lessons_used: Predictions frequently overestimated positive impact for neutral or negative changes, but underestimated large winning tests.
Sign-in hint changes (4 wins) and home wait_info changes (4 wins) can be helpful, though many tests showed no clear effect.
Sign-in reorder changes proved consistently harmful across agreeing tests.
Choose_path copy and choose_path layout changes can be helpful (each having 1 winning test), though other tests showed no clear effect.
Finish copy, home notification, choose_path redesign, and adoption hint changes showed no clear effect across agreeing tests with no wins.
Evidence remains thin or inconsistent for adoption redesign, adoption new_flow, finish new_flow, finish new_screen, home new_flow, and single-test categories.

candidates.title: Sign-In Account Safety Persistence Callout
candidates.change: Displays a prominent reassurance hint on the sign-in screen informing users that signing in prevents pet data loss across device reboots.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again, and sign-in reassurance hints have proven successful in past iterations.

sign_in.hint: Signing in links your pet securely so your desktop companion is never lost or reset.

guard.reason: Adds a reassuring security hint on the sign-in screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in hints have strong past performance (4 wins) and address direct support feedback.

candidates.title: Path Selection Overview Grid Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the path selection screen into a visual grid layout with distinct choice cards highlighting quick-start versus custom pet options.
candidates.why: Choose path layout improvements have shown positive impact, helping users quickly understand options and reduce initial drop-off.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Pet Creation Path
choose_path.body: Select whether you want to quickly adopt a ready companion or build a custom pet from scratch.

guard.reason: Redesigns choose path screen into a grid layout while preserving both adoption and custom pet creation options.

candidates.score_note: Path redesigns have historically underperformed (-1.3% avg) and carry high implementation cost.

candidates.title: Desktop Render Waiting Estimate Banner
candidates.change: Adds an estimated time indicator and visual render progress bar on the waiting screen while the desktop pet initializes.
candidates.why: Home wait time averages over 200 seconds median; wait_info changes on home have produced 4 past winning tests by reducing user anxiety during long rendering times.

waiting.hint: Preparing your desktop pet graphics and background engine...

guard.reason: Adds standard render progress indicators and time estimates to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info changes have 4 past wins and target long median render wait times.

candidates.title: Desktop Quick Controls Overview Screen
candidates.change: Inserts a dedicated quick controls reference screen right before completion detailing how to hide, summon, and interact with the pet on the desktop.
candidates.why: Support receives inquiries from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet once setup completes.

new_controls_quickref.headline: How to Control Your Desktop Pet
new_controls_quickref.body: Right-click the system tray icon to hide, summon, or open settings for your pet at any time.

guard.reason: Adds a new controls overview screen before home intro without skipping required steps.

candidates.score_note: Adding new screens at finish step consistently shows negative lift (-0.7% across 7 tests).

candidates.title: Sign-In Multi-Device Sync Guarantee Hint
candidates.change: Adds a clear hint on sign-in clarifying that account sync automatically backs up pet progress to cloud servers.
candidates.why: Addressing account persistence concerns directly on sign-in targets the top customer support theme (8 emails regarding missing/reset pets).

sign_in.hint: Cloud auto-sync enabled: your pet profile and items are preserved whenever you log in.

guard.reason: Adds a cloud backup reassurance hint to the sign-in screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in hints effectively address top support complaint regarding account data persistence.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Waiting Companion Flow
candidates.change: Introduces a temporary interactive mini-activity screen during pet generation so users can preview pet behaviors while waiting for render completion.
candidates.why: Mean wait time for home generation reaches 2336s; adding interactive waiting screens keeps users engaged during background rendering.

new_waiting_mini_game.headline: Preview Desktop Interactions
new_waiting_mini_game.body: Practice calling and feeding your companion while desktop graphics finish generating.

guard.reason: Adds an interactive waiting mini-game step during pet generation without omitting required screens.

candidates.score_note: New flows carry high effort and evidence for home new_flow shows negligible impact (+0.1%).

candidates.title: Choose Path Duration & Mode Guidance Copy
candidates.change: Updates the choose path headline and body text to set clear time expectations for quick adoption versus custom photo studio paths.
candidates.why: Clear path duration guidance helps users select the route that matches their available time, reducing early drop-offs.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Setup Experience
choose_path.body: Choose Express Adoption (1-minute setup) or Custom Pet Studio (photo generation).

guard.reason: Updates choose path copy to set clear duration expectations while retaining both adoption and custom choices.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path copy changes have positive past results (+2.9%) with low implementation effort.

candidates.title: Desktop Spawn Status Readiness Notification Banner
candidates.change: Enables an active notification toggle and progress indicator on the waiting screen to alert users when the desktop pet process is ready.
candidates.why: Users often minimize the application during long renders; explicit notification prompts prevent abandoned desktop sessions.

guard.reason: Adds waiting status banner and readiness notification settings to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Wait_info indicators on home step reliably reduce drop-off during long renders.

candidates.title: Home Intro Desktop Controls Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the home intro welcome screen into a split layout featuring interactive control instruction cards.
candidates.why: 78.7% finish conversion leaves room for improvement, and support reports reveal user confusion regarding pet controls post-onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Use system tray controls to interact, customize, or hide your companion anytime.

guard.reason: Redesigns the home intro welcome overlay to highlight controls layout.

candidates.score_note: Redesigning screens introduces user friction despite support relevance; redesigns lack wins.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Data Safety Hint
candidates.change: Adds a hint to the adoption certificate stage reassuring users that pet traits and naming data are automatically saved.
candidates.why: The adoption stage suffers from a 70.5% conversion drop-off; reassuring users about saved data reduces friction during trait finalization.

adoption_certificate.hint: Your pet customization and companion traits are safely recorded for your account.

guard.reason: Adds a data safety hint to the adoption certificate screen while preserving its primary function.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high drop-off but adoption hints have historically shown negative lift (-1.2%).

lessons_next: Predictions frequently overestimated positive impact for neutral or negative changes, but underestimated large winning tests.

Sign-in reorder changes proved consistently harmful across agreeing tests.

Choose_path copy, choose_path layout, choose_path redesign, finish new_flow, home new_flow, and adoption new_flow changes can be helpful (each having 1 winning test), though other tests showed no clear effect or negative impact.
